expected_issues.title: Hardcoded Secrets in Source Code
expected_issues.message: AWS_SECRET_KEY is hardcoded in source code, exposing cloud credentials if the repository is leaked or shared.
expected_issues.suggestion: Load secrets from environment variables or a secrets manager.

expected_issues.title: Path Traversal via unsanitized filename
expected_issues.message: User-supplied filename is joined to BACKUP_DIR without validation, enabling path traversal attacks (e.g. '../../etc/passwd').
expected_issues.suggestion: Resolve the path and verify it starts with BACKUP_DIR before accessing.

expected_issues.title: Command Injection via os.system with f-string
expected_issues.message: User-supplied 'name' is interpolated directly into a shell command via os.system, enabling command injection (e.g. 'x; rm -rf /').
expected_issues.suggestion: Use subprocess.run with a list of arguments and validate input before use.
